nonBlockingObservations.title: Distinguish sampling failures from a member that disappeared
nonBlockingObservations.detail: sample_tree silently skips a failed group_members call, and resident_bytes(...).ok() drops every per-member error. The comment explains the normal race in which a listed member has exited, but the code also suppresses other native sampling failures. The fixture controls establish successful observed/asserted enforcement, not an error policy for unavailable samples; repeated failures could leave the observed total partial without any reduced indication. This does not change the reviewed normal-path arithmetic or the unit’s explicitly provisional, fixture-scoped status.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Have the supervision owner specify how non-disappearance enumeration/RSS errors are distinguished and surfaced before production composition, and add focused injected-error controls. Preserve the legitimate exited-member race and do not report an unavailable/partial sample as a complete observed sum. No new limit constant or measurement claim is needed.
